QikCal · Privacy

Privacy policy

Effective 16 November 2026

QikCal is an offline food diary. Your diary stays on your device unless you choose to export or share it.

Information stored on your iPhone

QikCal stores the foods you log, their portions and times, your favourites, daily guide and reminder choice in a protected local file. The diary file is excluded from device backups. QikCal does not require an account.

Information QikCal collects

QikCal does not send diary information to QikCal or an analytics or advertising provider. The app does not include an analytics SDK, advertising SDK or server-side diary storage. Food search uses the bundled catalogue and works offline.

Website catalog search

The food guide can download the public catalog file from this site. After it loads, food searches and portion calculations run in your browser. The page does not send your search terms or entered weight to QikCal, add them to the page address, or save them.

Sharing and export

If you export your diary or share a weekly recap, iOS opens its system sharing interface. The data or image is sent only to the destination you select. That destination handles the information under its own privacy terms.

Notifications

If you enable a reminder, its time and notification are scheduled locally by iOS on your iPhone. QikCal does not send push notifications from a server. You can turn the reminder off in QikCal Settings or iPhone Settings.

Your choices

You can export or delete the local diary from QikCal Settings. Deleting the app removes its local diary file. If you choose to export or share information, keep in mind that the receiving destination may retain its own copy.

Children

QikCal is a general food diary and is not designed for children under 13. It does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Food information

The bundled QikCal Food Library contains 159,000 food records and works offline. Food values are estimates for general reference, not medical advice. Values may be missing or vary with ingredients and preparation.

Changes and contact

This policy may be updated if QikCal's features or data practices change. The current version will be available at this page. For privacy questions, email hello@qik.ai.
